A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
histograms are a crucial part for query processing, but they are not used in the way they should.
we have demonstrated how a data movement accelerator can be used to generate histograms as a side effect, without any additional overhead.
we show that the FPGA can be used for data movement and at the same time it can be used to calculate histograms on the same data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the data movement path is a promising place for implementing data-intensive tasks in a DBMS.
hardware acceleration can provide a significant boost in performance for data analytics.
